status: retrospective correction plan; not a prospective preregistration
health_trigger: decline_probability >= 0.8 OR cusum_alarm, using mature labels only
multiplicity: all 9 nonbaseline arms x 2 expressions = 18 contrasts; IID and circular block bootstrap; report larger p
return_contract: existing upstream fwd_ret = weekly open(t+5)/open(t+1)-1, four-week holding; five observations to maturity
missing_return: zero imputation, with counts and -100% sensitivity; exclude calendar tail before label maturity
hedge: long minus equal weight of same observable pool; not a fitted beta-neutral hedge
reporting: average terminal return across 4 independent phase accounts; no claim of synchronous live NAV; inference uses matched cycle averages
decision: diagnostic research only unless robustness, multiplicity and power criteria all pass
